name: Same Time Next Tuesday
source:
"Same Time Next Tuesday" follows Joe, a sleazy mechanic in the process of working out his issues and becoming a better man, recounting an incident that shakes up his life to his therapist, Horacio.

[From [url=https://nanoff.itch.io/tuesday]itch.io[/url]]

A spin-off of the Boomer's Big Date comic franchise.
